name: Lamorack de Galles

attributes.attribute: famous warrior of the Round Table
sons, including Gawain, killed Lamorack in revenge

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lamorack de Galles was an Arthurian hero. He was the son of King Pellinore and a famous warrior of the court. Lamorack slew the husband of Arthur's half-sister Morgause, which earned him her enmity. Her sons, Gawain among them, killed him in revenge. The feud destroyed a great knight of the realm.

okr.objective: Present Lamorack de Galles as an Arthurian hero undone by a family feud.
key_results: The source names him the son of King Pellinore.
It calls him a famous warrior of the Round Table.
It says he slew Morgause's husband and her sons killed him in return.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (Checkmark 2008), s.v. Lamorack de Galles.
